about.title: About
about.p1: Hi, I'm Jhonny, a frontend developer, i like to create great web experiences. I enjoy bringing ideas to life by building intuitive digital products.
about.p2: I have over 3 years of experience building cool user interfaces using some of most famous javascript frameworks and libraries.
about.p3: Outside of coding, you will usually find me playing video games, doing exercise, diving into new technologies, or spending time outdoors with my family.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: These are a few of my personal projects. I've also worked on private corporate projects that I can't showcase, but I'd be happy to discuss them.

cursed_waters.title: Cursed waters
cursed_waters.description: Just for fun - A 3D game where you defend a floating gem on a tropical island from waves of enemies. The game increases in difficulty with each raid, and you can heal and upgrade by collecting loot.

tesseract.title: Tesseract
tesseract.description: Freelance - A website where I offer my services as a web developer.
tesseract.technologies: Technologies: React, Typescript, Vitest, Tailwind CSS

strength_lab.title: Strength lab
strength_lab.description: Just for fun - A web app where users can create their account, log in, add friends, post, react to their friends' posts, create and edit their profile, and most importantly, create their gym workout routines.

my_crossy_road_game.title: My crossy road game
my_crossy_road_game.img_alt: My crossy road game website screenshot
my_crossy_road_game.description: Just for fun - In this game, the goal is to cross roads without getting hit, earning points for each successful move. Inspired by the classic Crossy Road, developed following Hunor Marton Borbely's tutorial.

pokemons.title: Pokemon app
pokemons.description: Technical test - The classic Pokémon web app where you can search for Pokémon by name and also filter them by type.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.description: Technical test - This is a web application built with Next.js that allows you to look up English words using the Free Dictionary API. The application displays definitions, pronunciations, usage examples, and more.
dictionary.technologies: Technologies: Next.js, Redux toolkit, Vitest, Tailwind
